content: Apache Hamilton is the named precedent for a 'micro-orchestrator': a library-only DAG executor with no server, portable to any Python process, function-per-node, async-capable, already integrated with Haystack in production (up to 1500 concurrent users). Confirms the embeddable-in-process runner pattern is proven at scale, though the frozen contract's tagged-sum NodeKind/effects[] declaration model is closer to Haystack's own typed-socket pipeline than to Hamilton's function-signature-inference style.
